_comment: Describes this standalone build for ../lesson-app-tools/. UNLIKE grades 1 to 4, this one is NOT wired to the platform shell: the pages are self-contained, with no module imports, no progress reporting, no Wehel and no hand-raise. deploy.mjs uploads the four shared modules unconditionally, so they land in the remote directory and nothing loads them. index.html is a real hub of six cards, generated with the lesson pages by split-into-lessons.py; squares-and-steps.html is that generator's INPUT and is deliberately not listed here, so it is not shipped.
subject: mathematics
